## Why

Axon Fusus agencies run white-label `Connect <Place>` camera-registration
pages — public opt-in programme surfaces whose *existence and stated
terms* are programme-level facts, while every registrant byte is Part
VIII-protected by construction (R11-A16: the community-camera presence is
a candidate, not a feed). The companion signal is the
`https://<host>:8443/faststream/login.html` screen — a FUSUS marked-host
fingerprint recorded evidence-only. This row lands the connector, the
committed six-site inventory, the reviewed vocabulary, the registry
wiring and the fixtures; it performs no live GET.

## What ships

- **`connectors/axon_connect.py`** — the `axon_connect` connector
  (eight-stage). `discover()` walks exactly the committed
  `data/axon_connect_targets.toml` inventory (a binding outside it
  refuses loud). `fetch()` = one polite GET per target through
  `ctx.fetcher` only (host opt-out → site opt-out → politeness →
  interstitial check → kind dispatch → **in-memory Part VIII screen over
  the embedded JSON payloads AND the canonical record** → admit), each
  outcome recorded on the connector's per-target ledger. Two target
  kinds: `connect_page` parses the registration page to allowlisted
  programme fields (programme name, modes offered, publisher, verbatim
  stated-use clauses + terms text) into `sig.axon-connect-page/1`;
  `marked_host_screen` records `sig.fusus-screen/1` (markers hit +
  status + sha256 + byte size — the login page's bytes are never stored).
  `capture()` persists ONLY the screened record — a `FetchResult` that
  never passed the screen is refused. Claims are allowlisted to four
  predicates (`camera_registration_portal` — new, `camera_registry_publisher`,
  `agency_name`, `portal_stated_prohibited_use`); screen captures emit
  exactly one `acquisition_candidate` row, never a claim.
- **Committed data** — `data/axon_connect_targets.toml`
  (`sig.axon-connect-targets/1`: the I9a-C003 six-site set with
  `expect` identity tokens, recorded lead evidence and an
  `opted_out_sites` column; fail-closed on drift) +
  `data/axon_connect_vocab.toml` (`sig.axon-connect-vocab/1`: screen
  markers/`min_hits`, page markers, stated-use patterns, terms element
  ids, the closed predicate allowlist, interstitial markers).
- **Registry wiring** — `sources.toml [sources.axon_connect]` (custody
  DERIVE — only screened records persist; `public_terms_only`;
  `robots_policy=honor`; `ingestion_permitted` absent→false;
  rights `UNDETERMINED`/`redistributable=false`/`review_needed=true`);
  `live_targets.toml` + `live_targets.py` (`axon_connect_targets` →
  `connect_targets()`); `runner.py` `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` + the
  fixture-run target-resolution set; `__init__.py` registers the module.
  The neighbouring `axon_community_connect` row is byte-for-byte
  untouched.
- **Screen membership** — `ops/at_rest_audit.toml`: `axon_connect*`
  added to I7-S1 (registrant names) + I7-S4 (residential coordinates);
  the connector consumes the SAME committed declaration through
  `evidence.screen` — no drifted copy.
- **Ontology** — `camera_registration_portal` (boolean; SLOW;
  `camera_registry` D1 / `connector_run` D3 directness) appended to
  `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml`; generated artifacts regenerated.
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_axon_connect.py` (25) + six
  committed fixtures under `tests/connectors/fixtures/axon_connect/`.
  Zero network — a `FakeTransport` serves canned pages through a real
  `PoliteFetcher`.
- **Leg-A queue + leg-B packet** —
  `docs/build/reports/rights/p3676/leg-a-queue.toml` (12 legs, all
  `queued`/`prepared_not_executed`, blocker recorded) +
  `leg-b-packet.md` (the operator's first-wire act staged — agent-drafted,
  go lines blank).

4. **Leg B held** — **D-P36.76-2** (kind V, OPEN): the operator's OP-26

5. **Size budget overage recorded** (≈2,320 non-generated/non-fixture

6. **Obligation-tooling note** — `obligation_events.py append` deadlocks
